headline: Field evidence of benefit over natural recovery: planting (after mechanical cleanup) (edge loss avoided by year 8 8.5 m (90% 2.5 to 14.9)); manual_removal (vegetation cover ratio gain at year 2 0.35 (90% 0.20 to 0.51)). Design of the evidence: planting (after mechanical cleanup): observational, one site: mechanically cleaned and planted plots versus untreated plots, 5 versus 9 plots (not a randomised comparison); manual_removal: observational, one site (Zengel et al. 2022, Bay Jimmy). Differences are experimental composer output from one site's field evidence. Conditional, not recommended outright: planting (after mechanical cleanup) (evidence of benefit exists, but the option presupposes 'mechanical_removal', which is excluded for this input; it applies only where that method has already been used).

inputs.ordering: within a class: lower bound of the 90% benefit interval where it exists (edge loss avoided by year 8 in m, then vegetation cover ratio at year 2, then literature lnRR lower bound; units are never mixed), then the ASSUMED ecological score (higher = lower disturbance first), then name

category_rules.conditional: class D (allowed, harm flagged under some conditions or mixed evidence), OR class A when the input is outside the scope where the benefit evidence was gathered (transfer untested), OR class A when the option presupposes a method that is itself excluded
category_rules.excluded: class E: removed by a hard constraint (screening rule or habitat rating) or by evidence of harm
category_rules.insufficient_evidence: class B with no eligible evidence rows: no comparison with natural recovery is possible
category_rules.natural_recovery_monitoring: class C: natural recovery, the reference every option is compared with
category_rules.no_demonstrated_benefit: class B with evidence rows that show no clear difference from natural recovery
category_rules.recommended: class A (evidence of benefit, no harm flag) AND the input is inside the scope where that evidence was gathered (scope tier 'validated')

outputs.headline: Field evidence of benefit over natural recovery: planting (after mechanical cleanup) (edge loss avoided by year 8 8.5 m (90% 2.5 to 14.9)); manual_removal (vegetation cover ratio gain at year 2 0.35 (90% 0.20 to 0.51)). Design of the evidence: planting (after mechanical cleanup): observational, one site: mechanically cleaned and planted plots versus untreated plots, 5 versus 9 plots (not a randomised comparison); manual_removal: observational, one site (Zengel et al. 2022, Bay Jimmy). Differences are experimental composer output from one site's field evidence. Conditional, not recommended outright: planting (after mechanical cleanup) (evidence of benefit exists, but the option presupposes 'mechanical_removal', which is excluded for this input; it applies only where that method has already been used).
